security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally uses the external sonos CLI to discover and control Sonos speakers on the local network. Most static command findings are benign markdown examples, but the core external-command behavior is real and should be treated as a controlled local-device action. No prompt injection attempt was found in the skill text.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the Go module installer to a reviewed version instead of github.com/steipete/sonoscli/cmd/sonos@latest.
Tell agents to request clear user confirmation before changing playback, volume, groups, favorites, or queues.

static_findings.snippet: Use `sonos` to control Sonos speakers on the local network.
- `sonos discover`
- `sonos status --name "Kitchen"`
- `sonos play|pause|stop --name "Kitchen"`
- `sonos volume set 15 --name "Kitchen"`
- Grouping: `sonos group status|join|unjoin|party|solo`
- Favorites: `sonos favorites list|open`
- Queue: `sonos queue list|play|clear`
- Spotify search (via SMAPI): `sonos smapi search --service "Spotify" --category tracks "query"`
- If SSDP fails, specify `--ip <speaker-ip>`.
- Spotify Web API search is optional and requires `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`.

content.user_title: Control Sonos Speakers from AI Tools
content.value_statement: Managing Sonos speakers from an AI session usually requires remembering command syntax and troubleshooting local network errors. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused Sonos CLI guidance for discovery, status checks, playback, volume, grouping, queues, and favorites.
actual_capabilities: Discovers Sonos speakers available on the local network.
Checks speaker status by room or device name.
Runs playback commands such as play, pause, and stop.
Adjusts volume for a selected Sonos speaker.
Manages groups, favorites, queues, and Spotify SMAPI search through sonoscli.
Explains common network permission errors for Codex and macOS environments.
limitations: Requires the external sonos binary to be installed and available on PATH.
Works only when the agent environment can reach the same local network as the speakers.
Some discovery commands may fail in restrictive sandboxes without network permission.
Spotify Web API search requires separate Spotify client credentials.

use_cases.title: Check Speaker State
use_cases.description: Ask the agent to discover Sonos speakers and report the current status of a selected room.

use_cases.title: Manage Shared Audio
use_cases.description: Control playback, volume, groups, and queues during meetings, events, or shared work sessions.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Local Discovery
use_cases.description: Diagnose common SSDP, sandbox, and macOS local network permission errors during speaker discovery.

prompt_templates.title: Find Speakers
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover the Sonos speakers on my local network and summarize the rooms you find.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Sonos status for the Kitchen speaker and tell me what is playing, if anything.

prompt_templates.title: Adjust Playback
prompt_templates.prompt: Set the Kitchen speaker volume to 15, then pause playback. Ask for confirmation before changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Discovery Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Sonos discovery, inspect any network or permission error, and explain whether macOS local network access or a sandbox setting is blocking it.

output_examples.output: The agent reports each discovered room, speaker name, and reachable status in plain language.

output_examples.input: Why did discovery fail with no route to host?
output_examples.output: The agent explains the local network permission issue and suggests checking macOS Local Network access for the host process.
The agent asks for confirmation, then reports whether the volume command completed successfully.

best_practices: Confirm the target room name before running state-changing speaker commands.
Use read-only discovery and status commands before playback, queue, or volume changes.
Check sandbox and local network permissions when discovery fails.
anti_patterns: Do not run group, queue, playback, or volume changes without clear user intent.
Do not assume a speaker IP address when discovery has not found the target device.
Do not expose Spotify credentials or place them in prompts, logs, or shared output.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the sonos CLI binary and local network access to the Sonos speakers.

faq.question: Does it work in Codex sandboxes?
faq.answer: It can work only when the sandbox permits local network access for discovery and speaker control.

faq.question: Can it control playback?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides commands for play, pause, stop, volume, grouping, queues, and favorites.

faq.question: Can it search Spotify?
faq.answer: It supports sonoscli SMAPI search and optional Spotify Web API search when credentials are configured.

faq.question: Does it store speaker data?
faq.answer: The skill file does not store speaker data. The external CLI may return live local network status.

faq.question: Why does discovery need network permission?
faq.answer: Sonos discovery uses local network communication, which some operating systems and sandboxes restrict by default.
